title: 1703: Refactor RCB into separate classes
body:
Fixes #1703

I have 2 small questions:
- Do we need to remove rcb component?
- Do we support Radio button in new Forces component?

comments_data.body:
1. Yes, let's throw RCB in the garbage bin.
2. We only need check boxes for Forces, not radio buttons (it is always multi select).

One last thing, please @lebaphi 

I'd like to trim down the props a bit more, please.  We allow both `number` or `string` values for `radio-buttons` and `check-boxes`.  Could you have a look at where these components are used, and check if both number and string are used?   If either isn't used for one component - could we remove it from the props?

> One last thing, please @lebaphi
> 
> I'd like to trim down the props a bit more, please. We allow both `number` or `string` values for `radio-buttons` and `check-boxes`. Could you have a look at where these components are used, and check if both number and string are used? If either isn't used for one component - could we remove it from the props?

@IanMayo currently only the Forces component is used and the options data are all strings, so I removed the number props in this components already.

Hey @lebaphi - it looks like the `CheckBoxes` component isn't used anywhere now. We can delete it :-)

Oh dear - I may be going mad here. It looks like `RadioButtons` isn't used anywhere either 😨 

Could you double-check that, and delete both classes if they aren't used anywhere please.

issues.title: Refactor RCB into separate classes
issues.body:
The RCB component is quite fragile, and has experienced a number of bugs.

Part of the fragility may be that it supports both Radio boxes and Check-boxes, which represent their data in different ways.  The props (especially update state handler) are poorly defined.   Oh, and there is "special handling" for lists of forces where colors are provided for the values.

Split into three components (one for RadioButtons, and one for CheckBoxes, one for Forces), and cover props (especially input data and change handler) with Typescript definitions.
